description: This PHP source file defines the RefreshTokenRepository class which implements refresh token management for an OAuth2 server within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for persisting, revoking, checking token revocation status, and generating new refresh token entities.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing OAuth2 refresh tokens, including persistence, revocation, and validation operations.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Persists a new refresh token entity into the database; throws exception if token ID must be unique.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Marks a refresh token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a refresh token has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of a refresh token entity.
